title: Lighten Windows evidence apply and retained-carrier Git work
outcome: Measure and reduce Windows Git process and wall-time cost for applying an evidence exchange against an already retained carrier.
acceptance: Record exact per-command Git starts and elapsed phases for one bounded Windows evidence apply and its retained-carrier preparation; separate fixture and product starts and offline replay.
Reduce unnecessary product Git starts and elapsed work while preserving custody, validation, and source rechecks at effects. Do not raise request deadlines or move coverage out of production tests.
